name: IconButton
description: Icon-only circular button. Matches Figma "IconButton — v2" component set (node 11174:146275). No Context axis — light/dark theming flows from the S2A variable modes (:root[data-theme]); knockout is the always-light circle for dark/media surfaces.

props.name: icon
props.description: Named icon from the built-in map, or a custom lit template (Figma Icon instance swap)

props.name: size
props.description: sm 24px/12px icon · md 32px/16px icon · lg 40px/16px icon

legacyPropMapping.description: v1's context prop is still accepted and mapped: context=on-dark with style=solid (or unset) → style=knockout. The context prop itself no longer exists — page theme comes from :root[data-theme].

knownTokenGaps: All v2 icon-button token names (s2a/color/icon-button/…, hyphenated) are bound in Figma but not yet in the shipped tokens release (shipped names use the old un-hyphenated 'iconbutton' path) — CSS chains each to a shipped var with identical light/dark resolution.
Sizes 24/32/40 map to primitives; sm 24px has no semantic spacing alias.

notes: Icon-only — aria-label is mandatory; the icon span is aria-hidden.
sm (24px) meets WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size exactly; avoid placing sm buttons flush against other targets.
